infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SoundGuard listens to your surroundings to recognise important sounds, and captions speech in real time. Audio is processed on this device and never uploaded by the app.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SoundGuard uses speech recognition to turn what people say into large, high-contrast captions you can read and show to the person you are talking to.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is attached to an SOS message so the people in your Safety Circle know where to find you. It is used only when an SOS is sent.
